name: ToolBench
intro: ToolBench 是 ToolLLM 框架中的工具使用基准，通过大规模真实 API、自动生成指令和解题路径标注来评估模型在真实工具调用场景中的规划与执行能力。
org: Tsinghua University, ModelBest Inc., Renmin University of China, Yale University, Tencent, Zhihu Inc.
build_method: RapidAPI采集, ChatGPT指令生成, 解题路径标注
eval_feature: 自动评测, API检索, 决策树搜索
intro_en: ToolBench is the tool-use benchmark released with ToolLLM. It measures whether language models can select, chain, and execute real APIs using automatically constructed instructions and solution paths.
build_method_en: RapidAPI collection, ChatGPT instruction generation, solution-path annotation
eval_feature_en: Automatic Evaluation, API Retrieval, Decision-Tree Search

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ToolLLM/ToolBench arXiv:2307.16789, Sections 3-4; official OpenBMB/ToolBench repository. ToolBench collects and filters 16,464 real APIs in 49 RapidAPI categories. ChatGPT generates diverse instructions from API documentation and human-written seed examples under single-tool, same-category multi-tool, and cross-category multi-tool sampling strategies. Generated instructions are filtered for relevant, non-hallucinated APIs. ChatGPT then calls live APIs while depth-first decision-tree search explores alternative paths; only executable solution traces are retained. At evaluation time a neural retriever selects candidate APIs, the agent reasons and calls tools, and ToolEval uses ChatGPT majority voting for pass rate plus pairwise comparison for win rate, with human checks validating the evaluator.
